messages:
Lina M.: Hey team — starting a thread to lock the run-of-show and fallback plan for the webinar next Tue (Balancing cost & quality for LLM inference). I sketched a 40-min agenda + 15-min live demo slot. Need speaker confirmations, demo fallback, and audience Q routing.

Samir P.: Thanks Lina. I can lead the demo. Quick ask: what model + dataset are we demoing? need a cheap fallback path if the dedicated pool spikes.

Lina M.: Plan is: primary = rwd-open-13b-q4 (hosted), fallback = rwd-8b-quant or cached canned responses for top 6 prompts. Demo dataset = 30 prompts from real customer prompt set (anonymized).

Kate R.: Could we add an 'offline recording' fallback? if live infer fails, we cut to a 2-min recorded run showing 13b latency/cost and a side-by-side with 8b quant. Saves stage time.

Ivy (ops): I'll provision a Dedicated test pool and set an autoscale boundary. Also will prewarm KV cache for the demo prompts. Need the exact prompt file by EOD tomorrow.

Samir P.: I'll assemble the prompt list today. Also propose adding a quick note in the panel about batching & prefix-cache impact — 60s demo slide + 3 sample traces.

Lina M.: Good. Proposed run-of-show (40+15):
1) 0:00-0:05 — Welcome + TL;DR (Lina)
2) 0:05-0:15 — Market framing + why serving matters (Kate)
3) 0:15-0:25 — Architecture deep dive (Samir)
4) 0:25-0:35 — Demo (Samir) 
5) 0:35-0:40 — Cost playbook & optimization tips (Lina)
6) 0:40-0:55 — Live Q&A + poll (all)

Kate R.: That looks tight but doable. Can we move cost playbook earlier 0:20-0:30 and demo 0:30-0:40 so demos finish before Q&A? audiences like to see demos earlier.

Lina M.: Fine. New order accepted.

Josh S.: I can own the poll/segmentation routing. We should add an inbound lead flow: 1) attendees who answer "enterprise" route to AE follow-up; 2) trials request go to self-serve email sequence. I'll draft the routing doc.

product-bot: New calendar invite created: Webinar — Balancing Cost & Quality — 2026-04-07 16:00 UTC. Speakers added: Lina M., Kate R., Samir P. Link: https://calendar.redwood.com/evt/abc123

Ivy (ops): For fallback automation: I'll add a runbook step that on 5xx or latency > 1.5s for >10 requests in a 30s window we: 1) switch the demo route to 8b-quant; 2) enable cached responses; 3) notify #release-war-room. Should I also add a manual cut-to-recorded step?

Samir P.: Yes, please include manual cut-to-recorded, with a 90s confirmation timer. Also add a small snippet we can paste into stage chat: "Switching to recorded demo due to live instability — we'll resume shortly"

Kate R.: Speaker notes: everyone please keep answers to 1–2 sentences during Q&A, and defer deep infra questions to post-webinar doc. We'll collect deep-dive asks via a form.

Lina M.: AV checklist:
- mic check 10 mins before
- demo machine dedicated account + cached prompts loaded
- private slack channel for stage (ops, speakers, producer)
- recorded fallback file location: gs://redwood-assets/webinars/balancing-cost-demo.mp4

Ivy (ops): I'll create the private channel and add ops + speakers. Also: I will run one full-dress rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 PDT. Can speakers confirm availability?

Samir P.: Confirmed for rehearsal.

Kate R.: Confirmed.

Lina M.: Confirmed.

Josh S.: I can do a quick pass next-day for poll/survey logic.

Lina M.: Outstanding asks/owners: 
- prompt file: Samir (due today)
- autoscale & cache prewarm: Ivy (due EOD tomorrow)
- poll routing doc: Josh (due Mon)
- recorded fallback upload: Ops (Ivy) (due tomorrow)
- slide deck revision (move cost playbook earlier): Kate + Lina (due Mon)

Kate R.: I'll also add one slide showing "quantization tradeoffs" with simple before/after latency numbers.

Samir P.: For the demo scripts, FYI here's a quick command I'll run to prewarm cache:

```bash
# prewarm prompts
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/infer -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY" -d '{"model":"rwd-open-13b-q4","prompt":"<prompt>"}'
```

Lina M.: Nice. One more: can we get a short 2-line blurb for the registration confirmation email that highlights the live demo + best practices? I'll send to comms.

Kate R.: Draft blurb: "Watch a live demo of cost vs quality in action — plus practical tips you can apply today to lower per-token costs without sacrificing model fidelity."

Lina M.: Perfect. Final: rehearsal time 09:00 PDT tomorrow, join private stage slack channel when you get the invite. Thanks all — will post final run-of-show after rehearsal. :raised_hands:
